title: Psalms Bible Quiz - Chapter 22
description: Ten questions on Psalms 22: a cry of being forsaken, mockers and bulls of Bashan all around, and praise of Yahweh in the great assembly.

questions.text: With what question does the psalm open?
questions.explanation: Psalms 22:1 opens with the words, 'My God, my God, why have you forsaken me?'

answers.text: My God, my God, why have you forsaken me?
Why have my friends left me?

questions.text: How does the speaker describe himself in verse 6?
questions.explanation: Verse 6 says, 'But I am a worm, and no man; a reproach of men, and despised by the people.'

questions.text: What do the people who mock the speaker say about him?
questions.explanation: Verses 7-8 say they shake their heads, saying, 'He trusts in Yahweh. Let him deliver him.'

answers.text: "Let him go back to his father's house."
"Let him bring an offering for his sins."
"He trusts in Yahweh. Let him deliver him."

questions.text: Strong bulls of which place have encircled the speaker?
questions.explanation: Psalms 22:12 says, 'Many bulls have surrounded me. Strong bulls of Bashan have encircled me.'

questions.text: To what does the speaker compare his heart in verse 14?
questions.explanation: Verse 14 says, 'My heart is like wax. It is melted within me.'

questions.text: According to verse 16, what have they pierced?
questions.explanation: Psalms 22:16 says, 'They have pierced my hands and feet.'

questions.text: For what do they cast lots?
questions.explanation: Verse 18 says they divide his garments among them and cast lots for his clothing.

questions.text: From the horns of what animals has the speaker been rescued?
questions.explanation: Psalms 22:21 says, 'Yes, you have rescued me from the horns of the wild oxen.'

questions.text: To whom will the speaker declare Yahweh's name?
questions.explanation: Verse 22 says, 'I will declare your name to my brothers. Among the assembly, I will praise you.'

questions.text: According to verse 28, whose is the kingdom?
questions.explanation: Psalms 22:28 says, 'For the kingdom is Yahweh's. He is the ruler over the nations.'

answers.text: The rich ones of the earth
